name: Vinkius AI Capabilities
description: Discover, connect, and manage AI Capabilities (Model Context Protocol servers) for AI agents. Managed infrastructure with authentication, metering, and zero-configuration setup for Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT, Windsurf, and more.

tools.name: search_ai_capabilities
tools.description: Search for AI Capabilities by keyword to find integrations for AI clients like Claude, Cursor, and ChatGPT.

query.description: The search keyword or phrase (e.g. 'email marketing', 'database', 'CRM').

tools.name: navigate_to_ai_capability
tools.description: Navigate to a specific AI Capability listing page. Returns capability details, available tools, setup instructions, and supported AI clients.

slug.description: The AI Capability slug — a URL-safe identifier (e.g. 'github', 'slack', 'notion', 'stripe'). Navigates to /ai-agent-connect/{slug}.

tools.name: browse_ai_capability_categories
tools.description: Navigate to the AI Capability category listing page to browse all available categories (CRM, DevOps, Finance, Marketing, Productivity, and more).

tools.name: view_pricing
tools.description: Navigate to the pricing page to see available subscription plans (Free, Lite, Starter, Pro, Business, Enterprise) for running AI Capabilities on Vinkius.

tools.name: get_current_capability_info
tools.description: Get structured information about the AI Capability on the current page — title, slug, description, category, listing type, and tool count. Only works on /ai-agent-connect/[slug] pages.

tools.name: start_authentication
tools.description: Open the authentication modal to sign in or create an account with Google or GitHub. Requires explicit user consent.

tools.name: navigate_to_client_guide
tools.description: Navigate to a step-by-step setup guide that explains how to give a specific AI client (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, and more) access to a specific AI Capability. Use this when the user asks how to connect an AI Capability to a particular AI client.

slug.description: The AI Capability slug — a URL-safe identifier such as "github", "slack", "notion", or "stripe".

client.description: The AI client to set up (e.g. "claude", "chatgpt", "gemini").
